messages:
maya: Quick sync — we have the launch next Wed (internal date). Need to lock press + analyst briefings: embargo window, who gets first look, quote signoff flow, and the factpack share method. Can we confirm slots and owners?

jess: I can run the press list. Proposal: embargo 24 hours for mainstream press, 48 hours for analysts/industry reports. Keeps us flexible for APAC. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

sam: 48h for analysts sounds right — gives them time for side-by-side. For quote approvals, product + CEO signoff required. Recommend a 2-hr SLACK-only approval window (fast), then fallback to email if needed.

leo: From sales: we need an inbound routing plan — if an analyst/press asks for follow-up demos, route to AE triage queue first, then SE deep-dive. I'll add an inbound tag in HubSpot.

maya: Good — who is primary for quote drafting? Jess can draft PR quote, but we need technical quote from Sam or Olga.

olga: I can prep a short technical quote + 2 line explainer for the factpack. Prefer us to avoid forward-looking claims.

jess: For factpack hosting — two options: secure GDrive link + access list, or Notion public view + embargoed share. GDrive is easier for access control.

maya: Let's do secure GDrive and post a readme in Notion. I'll create the folder and share with the list.

maya: Draft timeline suggestion:
- T-72h: factpack link + embargo email to analyst list (no quotes, just data)
- T-48h: full embargoed press release + quote drafts shared for signoff
- T-24h: final approvals due, media dry-run for top 3 analysts
- Launch: publish, open PR followup slots

sam: That timeline works. Add a canary slot for a friendly analyst (EU) at T-30h so we catch any surprises.

jess: Who is on the quote signoff chain? Confirming: Sam (tech lead), Maya (marketing), Tam (legal), CEO (final).

tam: Legal: please avoid metrics that imply SLAs unless we've recorded internal benchmarks. I need the factpack data points as CSV attached. Also want to review any model/comparison claims.

maya: Noted. I'll attach CSV to the factpack.

jess: I created a quick checklist (link): https://drive.google.com/placeholder-factpack — contains the PR draft, quote queue, and press list. Use comment threads for signoff.

briefing-bot: Reminder: schedule slots still open: Wed 10:00 PT, Wed 14:00 PT, Thu 09:00 PT. Use `/book-briefing` to claim.

olga: I'll take Thu 09:00 PT for the analyst dry-run.

leo: I'll own the inbound routing doc and update HubSpot tags by EOD.

jess: Quick nit: we should prepare a short FAQ (3 bullets) for analysts on security & data handling — many will ask about private deployment and logging.

sam: I'll draft the FAQ — 3 bullets + link to security page.

maya: Action items recap:
- Jess: finalize press list + PR draft (owner)
- Olga: technical quote + dry-run (Thu 09:00 PT)
- Sam: FAQ + signoff on tech quote
- Leo: HubSpot inbound routing + AE triage path
- Tam: legal review of factpack CSV & claims
- Maya: create GDrive factpack, send embargo emails T-72h

maya: Any blockers?

jess: None from me. Will ping if PR needs edits. :thumbsup:

leo: No blockers. Will sync with AEs for coverage.

tam: Please flag any model benchmarking language early.

maya: Cool — I'll schedule a 15-min pre-brief on Tue to walk through the signoff flow. Invite incoming.

jess: Thanks — will add to calendars.

sam: 👍

olga: 👍

briefing-bot: Note: remember embargo compliance — no pre-brief publish or public screenshots before final release.
